Peaches.name: Peaches
description: Your supervisor. Her cards <c=downside>DISARM</c> your ship and <c=status>FURY</c> to deal huge damage at once.

Carrie.name: Carrie
description: Your material handler. At her best early in a loop. Her cards offer either <c=keyword>very short-term</c> or <c=keyword>unique long term</c> benefits.

makeFast.cardSelectText:
Select a card to add <c=cardtrait>fast</c> to, forever.
(<c=cardtrait>Fast</c> cards don't ruin <c=cardtrait>priority</c> cards when they're played before them!)

removeFairTrade.name: trade
removeFairTrade.description: Lose 1 <c=artifact>FAIR TRADE</c> to get another <c=heal>repair yard</c> service.

Fury.name: fury
Fury.description: Add {0} damage to the next card attack.

HardWorker.name: hard worker
HardWorker.description: After playing a card that costs 2 or more <c=energy>ENERGY</c>, gain {0} <c=status>FURY</c>.

NeverendingRage.name: neverending rage
NeverendingRage.description: The next time you would lose any amount of <c=status>FURY</c>, instead lose 1 neverending rage.

Disarmed.name: disarmed
Disarmed.description: Attacks of {0} damage or less do nothing. <c=downside>Halves at end of turn, rounded down.</c>

FakeMissing1.name: crewmate 1 is missing
FakeMissing1.description: The next {0} <c=white>Crewmate 1</c> cards you play do nothing.

FakeMissing2.name: crewmate 2 is missing
FakeMissing2.description: The next {0} <c=white>Crewmate 2</c> cards you play do nothing.

CardFind.name: card find
CardFind.description: For each stack, at the end of combat, choose 1 of 3 cards to gain or skip.

ArtifactFind.name: artifact find
ArtifactFind.description: For each stack, at the end of combat, choose 1 of 2 artifacts to gain or skip.

Detour.name: detour
Detour.description: After combat, you may go to any map node in the next column.

DetourPlus.name: detour+
DetourPlus.description: After combat, you may go to any other map node.

priority.name: priority
priority.description: When a non-<c=cardtrait>priority</c> card is played, the top action is disabled for the turn.

tiring.name: tiring
tiring.description: Costs +1 <c=energy>energy</c> per zone you have completed this run.

mundane.name: mundane
mundane.description: This card is removed from everywhere at the beginning of the final boss fight.

PunchingBag.name: PUNCHING BAG
PunchingBag.description: Non-<c=dea0a0>Peaches</c> cards and non-card attacks ignore <c=status>DISARM</c>.

YogaLessons.name: YOGA LESSONS
YogaLessons.description: Whenever you receive <c=status>SHIELD</c> or <c=status>TEMP SHIELD</c>, spend 1 <c=status>FURY</c> to increase the amount gained by 1.

LifeSavings.name: LIFE SAVINGS
LifeSavings.description: Gain 1 extra <c=energy>ENERGY</c> every turn. <c=downside>If you ended your last turn with 0 energy, gain 1 <c=status>DISARM</c> and 1 less <c=energy>ENERGY</c>.</c>

FramedPhotograph.name: FRAMED PHOTOGRAPH
FramedPhotograph.description: When your ship would lose all its hull, gain 1 <c=status>PERFECT SHIELD</c> and 7 <c=status>FURY</c>. <c=downside>Can only trigger once.</c>

Megaphone.name: MEGAPHONE
Megaphone.description: Gain 1 extra <c=energy>ENERGY</c> every turn. <c=downside>Cards always cost at least 1 energy to play.</c>

BigGuns.name: BIG GUNS
BigGuns.description: When you deal <c=damage>4+ damage</c> to an enemy part in a single hit, <c=action>stun</c> it. If you deal <c=damage>16+ damage</c>, <c=action>total stun</c> the enemy instead.

Catalogue.name: CATALOGUE
Catalogue.description:
<c=keyword>+1 artifact option</c> in artifact offerings.
<c=keyword>+1 card option</c> in card offerings.

MultiTool.name: MULTI-TOOL
MultiTool.description: The odds of an offered card being upgraded are increased by an <c=keyword>additional</c> 25%.

Watch.name: WATCH
Watch.description: After every battle, you may choose a <c=cardtrait>temporary</c> card in your deck to keep until the next fight.

Forklift.name: FORKLIFT
Forklift.description:
Whenever you play an <c=card>upgraded <c=cardtrait>single-use</c> card</c>, add an <c=card>unupgraded</c> copy to the discard pile.
On pickup, choose a <c=cardtrait>single-use</c> card to upgrade.

Package.name: PACKAGE
Package.description:
On the <c=keyword>first turn of a boss fight</c>, add all packaged cards to your hand and remove this artifact.
Cards currently packaged:

RetrofittedParts.name: RETROFITTED PARTS
RetrofittedParts.description: Modifies the amount of energy you gain and cards you draw each turn.

FairTrade.name: FAIR TRADE
FairTrade.description: Spend 1 use at a <c=heal>repair yard</c> to get an extra service.

ElbowGrease.name: ELBOW GREASE
ElbowGrease.description: On pickup, remove a card of your choice. Then upgrade a card of your choice from the same deck.

SurveillanceDrones.name: SURVEILLANCE DRONES
SurveillanceDrones.description: Whenever you spend any amount of <c=status>FURY</c>, gain as much <c=status>TEMP SHIELD</c>.

PriorityMail.name: PRIORITY MAIL
PriorityMail.description: The first card you play each turn is <c=cardtrait>fast</c>.
